text:
Type: light wood coffee table
Use: holding drinks, books and decor; living room, reading corner
Style: Scandinavian, Japandi, mid-century modern
Materials: ash veneer top with striped grain, solid wood legs
Colors: light natural ash, pale blond wood with honey stripes
Shape: thin top with rounded corners and beveled edge, four round tapered legs splayed outward, light and open, low
Feel: airy, calm, natural, warm
Goes with: white or beige sofas, wool and linen textiles, plants; Scandinavian or Japandi living rooms

product.name: LISABO
product.description: The table surface in ash veneer and legs in solid birch give a warm, natural feeling to your room
